accuracy.finding: Projection and rates are consistent. Continuous and represented serial mechanics differ: mass about 8%, gravity/bias about 5.4%, with nonzero discarded modes. Combined dynamics/representation limitation, not an established projection bug.
accuracy.correction: Replace ONLY predictor reduced mechanics with constant-map virtual-work pullback M_r=B.T M_serial(Bq) B and f_r=B.T f_serial(Bq,Bv,u); preserve represented serial output, original reduced coordinates, all physical parameters, limits and production controller.
accuracy.limitations: Discarded serial modes remain excluded. Fixed-state projected full acceleration is not equal to constrained Galerkin acceleration. No claim to recover full backend dynamics.
accuracy.integration: Installed scipy Radau on 24-dimensional reduced ODE; non-advancing forward mechanics evaluations only; backend data.time remains zero; no mj_step or full-order rollout.
accuracy.numerical: Finite successful implicit solve and scaled reduced force-balance residual <=1e-5; last two successive vector AND speed differences <=1e-4. Old continuum reference is NOT a reference for changed mechanics.

cost.strategy: Seven candidate-specific NMPC replans at updates 0,5,10,15,20,25,30; execute each new plan next five inputs without intermediate feedback in predictor only. Production still replans all 35 times.
cost.warm_start: At each replan shift prior predictor plan by five executed intervals, truncate to actual horizon and regenerate using candidate current predicted state. No historical future states or inputs.
cost.assessment: One isolated initial controller-response probe against saved production actions, then two final combined histories. Do not infer exact controller behavior from fewer solves.
cost.economics: Count measured cold setup, graphs, seven solves, all propagation/output/serialization, and actual accepted research decision overhead per pair; compare with one skipped evaluation; abstention avoids zero.

scope: Retrospective development on frozen original-initializer pair and four local intervals. No safety authority or promotion. Future reset scenarios remain unobserved.
